scope: A real analysis started from Claude Code through the local IssueLens MCP server. It checks the integration (handshake, tool call, progress, report delivery), not analysis quality.
issue_choice: The same issue as the Codex run, so the two clients can be compared.

client.session: an interactive claude session in an empty folder, started and driven by the user
client.prompt: Use the issuelens MCP tool analyze_github_issue to analyze https://github.com/pallets/flask/issues/6146. Do not run shell commands or read local files. After the tool returns, reply with the report status, a two-sentence summary, the missing information, and the number of cited sources.
client.configuration: claude mcp add at local scope for the empty folder, with the server started through a logging relay; claude mcp list showed Connected before the session

server.settings: the checkout's .env, as for the web app

results.version_sequence: server/discover with 2026-07-28 answered -32601, then initialize with 2025-11-25

observations: Claude Code probed server/discover first and fell back to initialize, as in the step-one handshake.

Claude Code loaded the tool with ToolSearch before calling it: it defers MCP tool schemas, so the tool description entered the model context only then. The server instructions were in the session context from the start.
The session ran in auto permission mode, so the call ran without an approval prompt. The prompt in the default permission mode was not checked.
Claude Code sent an integer progressToken on tools/call and accepted all 14 progress notifications without an error.
The tool result in the session transcript is identical to the text the server sent, so Claude Code passed the 5,285-character report through without truncation.

Claude relayed the status, summary, empty missing_information and source count faithfully, pointed to the limitations for the real gaps, and counted which sources back a claim (S1-S4 and S6 of 8). It ran no commands and read no files.

The analysis was partial for the same reasons as the Codex run: the context budget omitted S5, the final maintainer comment, and forced early finalization. The draft reply was therefore written without that comment, and Claude warned the user to read it first. AGENT_CONTEXT_TOKENS stays at 12000 by decision.
Claude Code ended both connections (the health check and the session) without the relay seeing stdin close; no server or relay process remained afterwards.
